title: Arizer AC Adapter for V-Tower and Extreme Q
description:
Power up your Arizer Extreme Q and V-Tower desktop vaporizers with the Arizer AC Adapter. Designed for seamless compatibility, this DC19V power adapter ensures consistent performance, precise temperature control, and uninterrupted sessions. The AC110-240V power supply comes with a durable power cord, making it ideal for home use.

Whether you own the Extreme Q vaporizer, V-Tower power unit, or the original Extreme model, this Arizer power adapter keeps your device running efficiently. Stay powered and enjoy digital precision with this reliable replacement adapter for your desktop vaporizers. Order now and keep your sessions going strong!
